props.label: Fls A
props.html:
<div class="fls-a">
<style>@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Semi+Condensed:wght@600;700;800&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap");
.fls-a{--navy:#0A1A33;--navy2:#0E2A4F;--navy3:#133A6B;--blue:#0090D8;--blue2:#38B6EF;--soft:#E8F5FD;--red:#E63312;--red2:#B81F05;--ink:#15222F;--mut:#5A6E82;--line:#E2E9F1;--bg:#F4F8FC;--gut:20px;
 font-family:Outfit,system-ui,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.65;font-size:16.5px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;background:#fff;overflow-x:clip}
.fls-a *,.fls-a *::before,.fls-a *::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
.fls-a svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0}
.fls-a img{max-width:100%;display:block;height:auto}
.fls-a a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.fls-a h1,.fls-a h2,.fls-a h3,.fls-a h4{font-family:Outfit,system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.fls-a h1{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4.3vw,3.7rem)}
.fls-a h2{font-size:clamp(1.75rem,3vw,2.6rem)}
.fls-a h3{font-size:1.22rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2}
.fls-a p{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.fls-a .wrap{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--gut);padding-right:var(--gut)}
.fls-a .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:.6rem}
.fls-a .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:26px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--red)}
.fls-a .lead{font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--mut)}
.fls-a .ilink{color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(0,144,216,.3);transition:border-color .2s}
.fls-a .ilink:hover{border-color:var(--blue)}

/* buttons */
.fls-a .btn{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6rem;font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.08rem;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:.95rem 1.7rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.2}
.fls-a .btn::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-140%;width:55%;height:100%;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.38),transparent);transform:skewX(-22deg);transition:left .65s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.fls-a .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.fls-a .btn:hover::before{left:150%}
.fls-a .btn svg{width:17px;height:17px;transition:transform .28s}
.fls-a .btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}
.fls-a .btn-red{background:var(--red);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(230,51,18,.3)}
.fls-a .btn-red:hover{background:var(--red2)}
.fls-a .btn-wht{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34)}
.fls-a .btn-wht:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
.fls-a .btn-wht:hover svg{transform:none}
.fls-a .btn-pill{padding-right:.5rem;gap:1rem}
.fls-a .btn-pill .cir{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:transform .3s,background .3s}
.fls-a .btn-pill:hover .cir{background:#fff;color:var(--red);transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.fls-a .btn-pill:hover .cir svg{transform:none}

.fls-a .btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.fls-a .btn-navy:hover{background:var(--navy3)}
.fls-a .btn-line{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border:2px solid var(--line)}
.fls-a .btn-line:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.fls-a .btn-line:hover svg{transform:none}
.fls-a .sec{padding:96px 0}
.fls-a .shead{max-width:46rem;margin-bottom:2.6rem}
.fls-a .shead.center{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;text-align:center}
.fls-a .shead.center .eyebrow{justify-content:center}
.fls-a .shead p{color:var(--mut);font-size:1.08rem;margin-top:.9rem}
.fls-a h2 em,.fls-a h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue)}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.fls-a .a-hero{position:relative;padding:40px 0 84px;background:var(--bg);overflow:hidden}
.fls-a .a-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.55;
 background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(10,26,51,.05) 0 1px,transparent 1px 64px),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(10,26,51,.05) 0 1px,transparent 1px 64px);
 -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 40%,#000 20%,transparent 75%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 40%,#000 20%,transparent 75%)}
.fls-a .a-hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-12%;top:-30%;width:60%;height:140%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,144,216,.16),transparent 62%)}
.fls-a .a-hgrid{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.12fr) minmax(0,.88fr);gap:60px;align-items:center}
.fls-a .a-hgrid>*{min-width:0}
.fls-a .a-crumb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:1.4rem}
.fls-a .a-crumb a{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600}
.fls-a .a-crumb a:hover{color:var(--blue)}
.fls-a .a-crumb svg{width:13px;height:13px;color:#9AB0C4}
.fls-a .a-crumb span[aria-current]{color:var(--blue);font-weight:600}
.fls-a .a-htext{container-type:inline-size}
.fls-a .a-hero h1{font-size:min(7.4cqw,3.7rem)}
.fls-a .a-hero h1>span,.fls-a .a-hero h1 em{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.fls-a .a-hero .sub{font-size:1.12rem;color:var(--mut);margin-top:1.15rem;max-width:36rem}
.fls-a .a-hcta{display:flex;gap:.9rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:2rem;align-items:center}
.fls-a .a-ticks{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem 1.4rem;margin-top:1.9rem;list-style:none}
.fls-a .a-ticks li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);font-size:.96rem}
.fls-a .a-ticks li svg{width:20px;height:20px;padding:3px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--soft);color:var(--blue)}

.fls-a .a-hvis{position:relative;padding:0 0 0 26px}
.fls-a .a-hframe{position:relative;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 34px 70px rgba(10,26,51,.22);aspect-ratio:16/12}
.fls-a .a-hframe img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:70% 40%}
.fls-a .a-hvis::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:34px;bottom:-26px;width:62%;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--blue),var(--navy3));z-index:-1}
.fls-a .a-hvis{isolation:isolate}
.fls-a .a-seal{position:absolute;left:-8px;bottom:-30px;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(10,26,51,.35);display:grid;place-items:center;z-index:3}
.fls-a .a-seal svg.ring{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;animation:aSpin 22s linear infinite}
.fls-a .a-seal text{font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:11.4px;letter-spacing:.24em;fill:#fff;text-transform:uppercase}
.fls-a .a-seal .mid{position:relative;text-align:center;color:#fff;line-height:1}
.fls-a .a-seal .mid b{display:block;font-size:2.5rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.fls-a .a-seal .mid small{display:block;font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--blue2);margin-top:.3rem}
@keyframes aSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.fls-a .a-float{position:absolute;right:-14px;top:30px;z-index:3;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:14px 18px;box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(10,26,51,.2);animation:aBob 5s ease-in-out infinite}
.fls-a .a-float .ic{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center}
.fls-a .a-float .ic svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.fls-a .a-float b{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-weight:800;line-height:1.15}
.fls-a .a-float small{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:.84rem}
@keyframes aBob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}

/* ---------- stats ---------- */
.fls-a .a-stats{background:var(--navy);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.fls-a .a-stats::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-10%;top:-80%;width:50%;height:260%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,144,216,.25),transparent 62%)}
.fls-a .a-stats ul{position:relative;z-index:2;list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.fls-a .a-stats li{padding:44px 28px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#AFC6DC;font-size:.98rem}
.fls-a .a-stats li:first-child{border-left:0}
.fls-a .a-stats b{display:block;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,4vw,3.4rem);font-weight:800;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;margin-bottom:.55rem}
.fls-a .a-stats b span{color:var(--red)}

/* ---------- who we are ---------- */
.fls-a .a-who{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.95fr) minmax(0,1.05fr);gap:70px;align-items:center}
.fls-a .a-who>*{min-width:0}
.fls-a .a-whoimg{position:relative}
.fls-a .a-whoimg img{border-radius:26px;width:100%;aspect-ratio:760/580;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 26px 60px rgba(10,26,51,.18)}
.fls-a .a-whoimg::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-18px;bottom:-18px;width:46%;height:56%;border-radius:26px;border:3px solid var(--blue);z-index:-1}
.fls-a .a-whoimg{isolation:isolate}
.fls-a .a-whoimg .tag{position:absolute;left:22px;top:22px;background:rgba(10,26,51,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);color:#fff;font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.86rem;padding:.5rem 1rem;border-radius:999px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.45rem}
.fls-a .a-whoimg .tag svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--blue2)}
.fls-a .a-copy p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:1rem;font-size:1.04rem}
.fls-a .a-fix-h{margin-top:2rem;font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--navy)}
.fls-a .a-fixes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:.9rem}
.fls-a .a-fixes a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.fls-a .a-fixes a:hover{border-color:var(--blue);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(10,26,51,.1)}
.fls-a .a-fixes .ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--soft);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.fls-a .a-fixes a:hover .ic{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.fls-a .a-fixes .ic svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.fls-a .a-fixes small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);font-size:.84rem}

/* ---------- approach ---------- */
.fls-a .a-appr{background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--navy) 0%,#07162B 55%,var(--navy2) 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#C3D9EC}
.fls-a .a-appr::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.06;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#fff 0 1.5px,transparent 1.5px 74px),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0 1.5px,transparent 1.5px 74px)}
.fls-a .a-appr .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
.fls-a .a-appr h2{color:#fff}
.fls-a .a-appr .eyebrow{color:var(--blue2)}
.fls-a .a-agrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:56px;align-items:stretch}
.fls-a .a-agrid>*{min-width:0}
.fls-a .a-aimg{position:relative;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;min-height:440px}
.fls-a .a-aimg img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.fls-a .a-aimg .cap{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);color:var(--navy);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:center}
.fls-a .a-aimg .cap svg{width:22px;height:22px;color:var(--blue)}
.fls-a .a-acopy p.lead{color:#C3D9EC;margin-top:1rem}
.fls-a .a-vs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:2rem}
.fls-a .a-vs>div{border-radius:20px;padding:24px 22px}
.fls-a .a-vs h3{font-size:1.1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.fls-a .a-vs ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:.7rem}
.fls-a .a-vs li{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:flex-start;font-size:.97rem;line-height:1.5}
.fls-a .a-vs li svg{width:18px;height:18px;margin-top:2px}
.fls-a .a-vs .bad{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.fls-a .a-vs .bad h3{color:#9FB6CC}
.fls-a .a-vs .bad li{color:#8FA7BE}
.fls-a .a-vs .bad li svg{color:#E86A52}
.fls-a .a-vs .good{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.28);position:relative}
.fls-a .a-vs .good::before{content:"Our way";position:absolute;top:-12px;right:18px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.78rem;padding:.25rem .8rem;border-radius:999px}
.fls-a .a-vs .good h3{color:var(--navy)}
.fls-a .a-vs .good li{color:var(--ink)}
.fls-a .a-vs .good li svg{color:#1F9D57}
.fls-a .a-acopy .more{margin-top:1.8rem;color:#C3D9EC}
.fls-a .a-acopy .more a{color:#fff;font-weight:600;border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(56,182,239,.6)}
.fls-a .a-acopy .more a:hover{border-color:#fff}

/* ---------- credentials ---------- */
.fls-a .a-creds{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px}
.fls-a .a-cred{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:32px 28px 30px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,border-color .25s}
.fls-a .a-cred:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(10,26,51,.12);border-color:transparent}
.fls-a .a-cred::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--red));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .35s}
.fls-a .a-cred:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.fls-a .a-cred .ic{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--soft);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:1.3rem}
.fls-a .a-cred .ic svg{width:28px;height:28px}
.fls-a .a-cred .num{position:absolute;right:22px;top:16px;font-size:3.6rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--bg);letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1}
.fls-a .a-cred p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:.6rem}
.fls-a .a-acc{margin-top:28px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:24px;padding:30px 34px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:34px;align-items:center}
.fls-a .a-acc-h{font-family:'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy);font-size:1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem}
.fls-a .a-acc-h svg{width:24px;height:24px;color:var(--red)}
.fls-a .a-acc ul{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.fls-a .a-acc li{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 16px;display:grid;place-items:center;height:96px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(10,26,51,.06)}
.fls-a .a-acc img{max-height:70px;width:auto;object-fit:contain}

/* ---------- guarantee + team ---------- */
.fls-a .a-gt{background:var(--bg)}
.fls-a .a-gtgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:26px}
.fls-a .a-gtgrid>*{min-width:0}
.fls-a .a-guar{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--navy3),var(--navy));color:#C3D9EC;border-radius:26px;padding:44px 40px;overflow:hidden}
.fls-a .a-guar::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-20%;top:-40%;width:70%;height:160%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,144,216,.32),transparent 62%)}
.fls-a .a-guar>*{position:relative;z-index:2}
.fls-a .a-guar .eyebrow{color:var(--blue2)}
.fls-a .a-guar h2{color:#fff}
.fls-a .a-guar>p{margin-top:.9rem}
.fls-a .a-guar ol{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:1.6rem;counter-reset:g}
.fls-a .a-guar li{counter-increment:g;display:flex;gap:.9rem;align-items:flex-start;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px}
.fls-a .a-guar li::before{content:counter(g);flex:0 0 32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.95rem}
.fls-a .a-guar li b{display:block;color:#fff}
.fls-a .a-guar li span{font-size:.94rem}
.fls-a .a-guar .gstamp{position:absolute;right:30px;top:30px;width:84px;height:84px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.14);z-index:1}
.fls-a .a-team{background:#fff;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(10,26,51,.08);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.fls-a .a-team img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:820/460;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 35%}
.fls-a .a-team .in{padding:34px 36px 38px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
.fls-a .a-team p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:.9rem}
.fls-a .a-team .q{margin-top:1.4rem;border-left:4px solid var(--red);padding:.3rem 0 .3rem 1rem;color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;font-size:1.05rem}
.fls-a .a-team .btn{margin-top:auto;align-self:flex-start}
.fls-a .a-team .act{margin-top:1.6rem;display:flex;gap:.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* ---------- who we work with ---------- */
.fls-a .a-aud{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.fls-a .a-aud li{list-style:none;text-align:center;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px 16px 24px;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,background .25s}
.fls-a .a-aud li:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--blue);background:var(--soft)}
.fls-a .a-aud .ic{width:60px;height:60px;margin:0 auto 1rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center}
.fls-a .a-aud .ic svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.fls-a .a-aud b{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.06rem}
.fls-a .a-aud span{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:.9rem;margin-top:.35rem;line-height:1.5}

/* ---------- CTA ---------- */
.fls-a .a-cta-sec{padding:0 0 96px}
.fls-a .a-cta{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(118deg,var(--red) 0%,#C42508 100%);padding:56px 56px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:36px;align-items:center;color:#fff}
.fls-a .a-cta::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.1;background-image:radial-gradient(#fff 1.2px,transparent 1.2px);background-size:18px 18px}
.fls-a .a-cta::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-6%;top:-70%;width:40%;height:240%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.22),transparent 62%)}
.fls-a .a-cta>*{position:relative;z-index:2;min-width:0}
.fls-a .a-cta .eyebrow{color:#FFD9CF}
.fls-a .a-cta .eyebrow::before{background:#fff}
